Galle Fort, South Coast

Galle Dutch Fort Sunset Rampart Discovery

Explore 400 years of living history, architecture, spice traders, and jewelers inside the UNESCO 17th-century seaside fortress.

Add This Activity to My TourChat About This on WhatsApp

Experience Overview

Wander along cobblestone lanes flanked by Dutch colonial villas, shaded verandas, and the iconic white lighthouse. Your guide reveals hidden courtyards, tales of spice trade galleons, and the best vantage points on the bastions as the sun sets over the Indian Ocean.
